laws.rule: Copolia Trail: SPGA lists a paid ticket requirement for non-resident adults and visiting hours of 08:00 to 16:00 daily. Keep the ticket for ranger checks. On-site entry payments are by card only; cash is accepted at the SPGA main-office accounts section, not at the site. The government Plaisance profile explicitly identifies Copolia as a sub-district.
